meta.themes: Agent Platforms, Coding Agents, AI Infrastructure, AI Policy

news.title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex became available on AWS
news.summary: OpenAI said its frontier models and Codex are generally available through AWS, giving enterprises a way to use OpenAI capabilities inside existing AWS security, procurement, billing, and governance workflows.

news.title: Microsoft Build centered on agent platforms and MAI models
news.summary: Microsoft used Build 2026 to introduce Microsoft IQ context layers, Scout work agents, Agent 365 governance, new MAI models, and Windows execution containers for local agent runtimes.

news.title: Anthropic confidentially submitted a draft S-1
news.summary: Anthropic said it confidentially submitted a draft Form S-1 to the SEC for a proposed IPO, with share count and pricing still unset and timing dependent on SEC review and market conditions.

news.title: NVIDIA and Microsoft expanded the stack for agentic AI
news.summary: NVIDIA detailed a Microsoft Build partnership spanning RTX Spark and DGX Station for Windows, OpenShell secure runtime, NVIDIA models on Foundry, accelerated Fabric warehouses, and physical AI tooling.

news.title: OpenAI framed Codex as a broader knowledge-work tool
news.summary: OpenAI described Codex adoption beyond code, highlighting parallel tasks for data analysis, research, artifact creation, and workflow automation as knowledge workers use agentic execution.

news.title: Anthropic expanded Project Glasswing to 150 organizations
news.summary: Anthropic expanded Project Glasswing beyond its initial security cohort to about 150 organizations across more than 15 countries, focusing on critical infrastructure and widely used software vendors.

news.title: GitHub opened the Copilot app preview to more customers
news.summary: GitHub expanded Copilot app technical preview access and added canvases, cloud sessions, cloud automations, agentic browsing, voice, and shared session state across app and CLI surfaces.

news.title: Google introduced Gemma 4 12B for local multimodal agents
news.summary: Google introduced Gemma 4 12B as a mid-sized multimodal model for laptops, adding native audio inputs, local inference options, Gemma skills, and deployment paths through Google Cloud.

news.title: Amazon Bedrock redesigned its console for OpenAI and Anthropic APIs
news.summary: AWS launched a Bedrock console experience optimized for OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, adding model comparison, projects, evaluations, usage insights, and generated SDK snippets.

news.title: NVIDIA AI Cloud ecosystem expanded across regions
news.summary: NVIDIA said its AI Cloud ecosystem is expanding AI factory capacity across six continents to support frontier model builders, enterprises, sovereign AI programs, agentic AI, physical AI, and inference demand.

news.title: Alphabet outlined an AI-driven capital and cloud expansion
news.summary: Alphabet's June investor presentation tied its equity raise and infrastructure expansion to AI demand, citing Google Cloud AI adoption, TPU expansion, Gemini usage, and enterprise AI backlog.

news.title: U.S. moved to accelerate national-security AI use
news.summary: Reuters reported that a White House memorandum called for faster AI adoption in national-security applications while stressing limits on unlawful surveillance and updates to autonomous weapons guidance.
